Name: Orbitz
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE] 01/31/17 - [/b]ALL version fixed, sorry guys/gals! I mistyped a 'redirect' line (Abigail was supposed to be MarriageDialogueAbigail). I also discovered more small typos in some character dialogue so another update is imminent.. Eventually.

I started modding SDV for one of my nieces who had soon become obsessed and quickly discovered some of the townsfolk have a few words that children probably shouldn't be exposed to so I figured why not remove them. This also fixes a few grammar and spelling errors, this includes the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/383/?]No More Talking Walks[/url] fix for Abigail I released previously. I'll also be releasing a mod that reverses this action, giving everyone a potty mouth. Sorry, no pictures of the swearing captions simply because it defeats the purpose of seeing them and the fact I am slowly becoming more and more lazy.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cYWTw4Yl.png[/img]

(This said 'insulated' rather than 'isolated' in the official release.)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fDO7JQhl.jpg[/img]

[b]NOT available from stardewmods.com OR stardewvalleymods.net.[/b]
